_doc: Manual corrections of author-diagram gold graphs, applied by build_gold_review.py (_Gold.apply_corrections) after the diagram is parsed. Per paper a list of {op, ...}: reverse / drop an arrow {from, to}, or tag a box non_result {box}. A box is named by its \ref label set (a list) or by words of its text (a string). 'why' records the evidence in the paper.

2606.28030.why: Drawn Cor1 -> Prop5 (both figures), but Cor1's proof opens 'From Proposition~\ref{prop:search_problem}, we have ...': Cor1 uses Prop5.

2608.00304.why: An 'ext' (italic, unframed) technique note, not a result of the paper; no \ref.
